mapper.select: select config_version from execution_environment where environment_id = #{id} for update
mapper.insert: insert into execution_namespace_owner(instance_id, adapter_type, catalog_name, schema_name, environment_id) values(#{input.connection.instanceId}, #{input.connection.type}, #{input.catalog}, #{input.schema}, #{id}) on conflict do nothing
insert into execution_environment_version(environment_id, config_version, execution) values(#{id}, #{version}, cast(#{execution} as jsonb))
mapper.sql: select e.environment_id, e.name, e.config_version, cast(v.execution as text) as execution from execution_environment e join execution_environment_version v on e.tenant_id = v.tenant_id and e.environment_id = v.environment_id and e.config_version = v.config_version
